About the Mountain Mondays group ride

Free all-levels mountain bike ride from the campus bike shop into the Boise foothills. New riders get trail technique, trailside repair basics and an intro to the Ridge to Rivers trails. Runs from the start of fall semester until the time change, then again late March to May. Dates are posted on the shop's Instagram.
